audience: NAP Action Plan team, GGGI counterparts, and Thai sector agencies working on adaptation indicators
decision_use: Read the GGA thematic and dimensional targets in Thai alongside the already-translated GGA indicator set, so target wording and indicator wording can be cited as one coherent reference
section_job: Render the GGA target text of draft decision -/CMA.7 into Thai with clause-level fidelity, matching the terminology already established in GGA_indicator_TH.csv
target_altitude: Reference document. Full clause preservation; no summarisation, no executive compression, no interpretive gloss.
report_specific_rules: This is a TRANSLATION unit, not an argued-prose unit. Stages 1-3 of the harness (argument map, blueprint gate, verbalization) are deliberately not run: treaty text carries no governing thought or SCQA arc to construct, and fidelity is the controlling requirement rather than synthesis. transformation_mode is recorded as 'rewrite' because the schema admits only rewrite/synthesis/new; the operative mode is translate.
Register: formal Thai official, matching GGA_indicator_TH.csv
Key English term retained in parentheses on first use, per the CSV convention
No clause may be dropped, merged, or summarised; no content may be added
Standardise 'Indigenous Peoples' to ชนเผ่าพื้นเมือง (CSV uses both ชนพื้นเมือง and ชนเผ่าพื้นเมือง; the latter is more frequent)
Heading levels: all targets sit at a single uniform level (###) beneath the two ## section headers for thematic and dimensional targets, replacing the source's inconsistent mix of # and ##
No active-actor convention applies: the targets have no consultant voice. Subject is ภาคี (Parties) where the source says so.
inclusions: Parallel English source text above each Thai rendering
Provenance header naming draft decision -/CMA.7, Belem, 10-21 November 2025, agenda item 8(a)
Translator's note recording the 9(f) gap and terminology decisions
exclusions: Commentary, analysis, or implications for Thailand's NAP
Any edit to the source file
evidence_policy: The English source text is the sole evidence base and is reproduced verbatim beside each Thai rendering so fidelity can be checked line by line. Terminology is anchored to GGA_indicator_TH.csv rather than chosen fresh.
required_concepts: clause-level fidelity to the decision text

translation_notes.source_gap: RESOLVED 2026-09-11. Target 9(f) was absent from the source on the first pass; Boss added its wording to the source file and it was translated in a second pass. The gap section that stood in its place has been replaced by the translation. The theme inferred from indicators GGA-9f(a)/(b)/(c) during the first pass — poverty and social protection — matched the actual target text.
translation_notes.divergence_from_reference_sample: Two declared divergences from GGA_indicator_TH.csv, both decided by Boss rather than silently propagated. (1) 'exposure to risks': the CSV row 10a(b) renders it การเปิดเผยต่อความเสี่ยง (เปิดเผย = to disclose); this translation uses การเปิดรับ, the correct sense for risk exposure. (2) 'traditional knowledge': the CSV uses ความรู้ดั้งเดิม and never uses ภูมิปัญญา; Boss edited this draft to ภูมิปัญญาท้องถิ่น on 2026-09-11 and confirmed it should stand. Scope of that decision is THIS DOCUMENT ONLY — GGA_indicator_TH.csv and LEXICON_TH.json are deliberately left unchanged. Known effect: ท้องถิ่น now serves both 'traditional knowledge' (ภูมิปัญญาท้องถิ่น) and 'local knowledge systems' (ระบบความรู้ท้องถิ่น) in target 9(g); Boss judged ภูมิปัญญาท้องถิ่น a settled compound that Thai policy readers parse as a unit.
translation_notes.reference_sample_defects: CSV rows GGA-10a(c) and GGA-10a(f) carry PDF-extraction corruption (การจัดตัhง, เฝhาระวัง, สนบั สนุน). Not corrected here; out of scope.
